title: Psychology Facts
hook: Ever learn a new word, then see it everywhere?
facts: That is the frequency illusion, sometimes called the Baader Meinhof phenomenon.
The word was not suddenly more common. It was always there.
Your brain simply started paying attention to it, and ignored it before.
So when the universe sends you signs, it is mostly your attention doing the work.
outro: Follow for a new mind blowing fact every day.
